items.name: kart-mint
items.prompt: A single cute battle go-kart character for a top-down cartoon kart brawler, viewed from a high three-quarter top-down angle, the kart nose pointing exactly to the right along the horizontal axis at zero degrees because the game engine rotates this sprite at runtime. Chunky rounded mint-green kart body with a soft teal shadow panel and a cream racing stripe, fat black rubber tires with pale grey hubcaps, a short rounded rear spoiler, two tiny round side mirrors like little ears. The front hood carries a large smooth blank cream-white rounded faceplate panel, completely empty with no eyes, no mouth and no face drawn on it, because the game draws a cartoon face there. Tiny leaf antenna on the back. Style: cute cartoon video game art, glossy toy-like stylized 3D render with chunky rounded shapes, clean soft shading, bright candy colors, cheerful and adorable, soft even studio lighting with a mild highlight on the upper left, no hard cast shadow, no text, no watermark, no logos. Centered single object, isolated on a flat pure white background, no horizon, no ground shadow.
